# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/Makefile
PLAYBOOK_DIR := playbooks

.PHONY: help
help:
	@echo "Available targets:"
	@echo "  all                    - Run all playbooks sequentially"
	@echo "  setup-server           - Initial server setup"
	@echo "  setup-docker           - Setup Docker"
	@echo "  setup-docker-swarm     - Setup Docker Swarm"
	@echo "  deploy-traefik         - Deploy Traefik"
	@echo "  deploy-portainer       - Deploy Portainer"
	@echo "  deploy-hashicorp-vault - Deploy HashiCorp Vault"
	@echo "  deploy-lgtm            - Deploy LGTM stack"
	@echo "  graph                  - Show inventory graph"

.PHONY: lint
lint:
	yamllint .
	ansible-lint

.PHONY: syntax
syntax:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/00-all.yml --syntax-check

.PHONY: check
check:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/00-all.yml --check --diff

.PHONY: graph
graph:
	ansible-inventory --graph

.PHONY: all
all:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/00-all.yml --ask-become-pass

.PHONY: setup-server
setup-server:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/01-setup-server.yml --ask-become-pass

.PHONY: setup-docker
setup-docker:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/02-setup-docker.yml

.PHONY: setup-docker-swarm
setup-docker-swarm:
	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/03-setup-docker-swarm.yml

.PHONY: deploy-hashicorp-vault
deploy-hashicorp-vault:

.PHONY: deploy-portainer

	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/05-deploy-portainer.yml

.PHONY: deploy-traefik

	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/06-deploy-traefik.yml

.PHONY: deploy-postgres

	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/07-deploy-postgres.yml

.PHONY: deploy-lgtm

	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/09-deploy-lgtm.yml

	ansible-playbook $(PLAYBOOK_DIR)/10-deploy-gitlab.yml

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/playbooks/01-setup-server.yml
---
- name: Base OS Hardening and Prerequisites Setup
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: true
  roles:
    - role: set_netplan
    - role: set_hostname
    - role: set_timezone
    - role: set_repository
      when:
        - set_repository_apt_urls | default([]) | length > 0
        - set_repository_repositories | default([]) | length > 0
    - role: set_packages
    - role: set_users
    - role: set_firewall
      vars:
        set_firewall_ssh_port: "{{ ssh_port }}"
    - role: set_ssh
      vars:
        set_ssh_port: "{{ ssh_port }}"
    - role: set_motd

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-alertmanager/defaults/main.yml
---
alertmanager_domain: "alert.localhost"
alertmanager_image_tag: "v0.33.1"
alertmanager_data_path: "/opt/lgtm/alertmanager"

telegram_bot_token: ""
telegram_chat_id: 0
telegram_api_url: "https://api.telegram.org"


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-alertmanager/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Create Alertmanager directories
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - "{{ alertmanager_data_path | dirname }}"
    - "{{ alertmanager_data_path }}"

- name: Generate Alertmanager config
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: config.yml.j2
    dest: "{{ alertmanager_data_path }}/config.yml"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"

- name: Deploy Alertmanager stack
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: deploy-docker-stack
  vars:
    stack_name: alertmanager
    stack_compose_path: "{{ alertmanager_data_path }}/compose.yml"


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-alertmanager/templates/compose.yml.j2
services:
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:{{ alertmanager_image_tag }}
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/config.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
      - '--web.external-url=https://{{ alertmanager_domain }}'
    networks:
      - traefik-public
      - grafana-internal
    volumes:
      - "{{ alertmanager_data_path }}/config.yml:/etc/alertmanager/config.yml:ro"
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    deploy:
      labels:
        - "traefik.enable=true"
        - "traefik.http.routers.alertmanager.rule=Host(`{{ alertmanager_domain }}`)"
        - "traefik.http.routers.alertmanager.entrypoints=websecure"
        - "traefik.http.routers.alertmanager.tls=true"
        - "traefik.http.services.alertmanager.loadbalancer.server.port=9093"
        # - "traefik.http.routers.alertmanager.middlewares=auth-alertmanager@file"
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.hostname == {{ groups['mntr'][0] }}
      restart_policy:
        condition: on-failure
        delay: 10s
        max_attempts: 3

volumes:
  alertmanager_data:

networks:
  traefik-public:
    external: true
  grafana-internal:
    external: true


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-alertmanager/templates/config.yml.j2
# {{ ansible_managed }}

global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m

route:
  receiver: "telegram"
  group_wait: 10s
  group_interval: 30s
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
    - match:
        severity: critical
      receiver: "telegram"

receivers:
  - name: "telegram"
    telegram_configs:
      - api_url: "{{ telegram_api_url }}"

  # TLS-проверка: handshake + expiry сертификата
  tls_connect:
    prober: tcp
    timeout: 10s
    tcp:
      tls: true
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true   # self-signed CA от Vault
        server_name: ""              # берётся из target

  # HTTP-проверка: доступность + TLS
  https_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 10s
    http:
      valid_status_codes: [200, 301, 302, 307, 401, 403]
      method: GET
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4

  # HTTP-проверка с ожиданием 200
  https_strict:
    prober: http
    timeout: 10s
    http:
      valid_status_codes: [200]
      method: GET
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4

  delegate_to: "{{ stack_manager_host }}"

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-gitlab-runner/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Install prerequisite packages on CICD node
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
      - curl
      - ca-certificates
      - tzdata
      - perl
      - git
    state: present
    update_cache: true

- name: Check if GitLab Runner repository is already added
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /etc/apt/sources.list.d/runner_gitlab-runner.list
  register: gitlab_runner_repo_file

- name: Download GitLab Runner repository script
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: "https://packages.gitlab.com/install/repositories/runner/gitlab-runner/script.deb.sh"
    dest: /tmp/gitlab-runner-repo.sh
    mode: "0755"
  when: not gitlab_runner_repo_file.stat.exists

- name: Add GitLab Runner repository
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: /tmp/gitlab-runner-repo.sh
  when: not gitlab_runner_repo_file.stat.exists
  changed_when: true

- name: Remove GitLab Runner repository script
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /tmp/gitlab-runner-repo.sh
    state: absent

- name: Install GitLab Runner package
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: gitlab-runner
    state: present
    update_cache: false

- name: Ensure gitlab-runner user exists
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: gitlab-runner
    shell: /bin/bash
    home: /home/gitlab-runner
    create_home: true
    state: present

- name: Ensure gitlab-runner home permissions
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /home/gitlab-runner
    state: directory
    owner: gitlab-runner
    group: gitlab-runner
    mode: "0750"

- name: Add gitlab-runner user to docker group
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: gitlab-runner
    groups: docker
    append: true
  notify: Restart gitlab-runner

- name: Create GitLab Runner directories
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - "{{ gitlab_runner_config_path }}"
    - "{{ gitlab_runner_config_path }}/certs"

- name: Fetch Vault CA from mgmt node
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: /opt/vault/certs/root-ca.crt
  delegate_to: "{{ groups['mgmt'][0] }}"
  register: vault_ca_file

- name: Install Vault CA for GitLab Runner
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_ca_file.content | b64decode }}"
    dest: "{{ gitlab_runner_tls_ca_file }}"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  notify: Restart gitlab-runner

- name: Install Vault CA as GitLab domain certificate
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_ca_file.content | b64decode }}"
    dest: "{{ gitlab_runner_config_path }}/certs/{{ gitlab_domain }}.crt"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  notify: Restart gitlab-runner

- name: Install Vault CA into system trust store
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_ca_file.content | b64decode }}"
    dest: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/vault-ca.crt
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  register: vault_system_ca

- name: Update system CA certificates store
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: update-ca-certificates
  when: vault_system_ca.changed
  changed_when: true

- name: Check if GitLab Runner is already registered
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: gitlab-runner verify
  register: runner_verify
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Register GitLab Runner
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: >
      gitlab-runner register
      --non-interactive
      --url "https://{{ gitlab_domain }}"
      --token "{{ gitlab_runner_token }}"
      --description "{{ gitlab_runner_description }}"
      --executor "{{ gitlab_runner_executor }}"
  changed_when: true
  when:
    - gitlab_runner_token | default('') | trim | length > 0
    - runner_verify.rc != 0
  notify: Restart gitlab-runner
  no_log: true

- name: Generate GitLab Runner configuration
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: config.toml.j2
    dest: "{{ gitlab_runner_config_path }}/config.toml"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0600"
  no_log: true
  notify: Restart gitlab-runner

- name: Verify Docker is accessible by gitlab-runner
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker info
  become: true
  become_user: gitlab-runner
  environment:
    HOME: /home/gitlab-runner
  changed_when: false

- name: Verify Docker Buildx is available for gitlab-runner
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker buildx version
  become: true
  become_user: gitlab-runner
  environment:
    HOME: /home/gitlab-runner
  changed_when: false

- name: Verify GitLab Runner configuration
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: gitlab-runner verify
  changed_when: false


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-gitlab-runner/templates/config.toml.j2
# {{ ansible_managed }}

concurrent = {{ gitlab_runner_concurrent }}
check_interval = {{ gitlab_runner_check_interval }}

[session_server]
  session_timeout = {{ gitlab_runner_session_timeout }}

[[runners]]
  name = "{{ gitlab_runner_description }}"
  url = "https://{{ gitlab_domain }}"
  token = "{{ gitlab_runner_token }}"
  executor = "{{ gitlab_runner_executor }}"
  tls-ca-file = "{{ gitlab_runner_tls_ca_file }}"

  environment = [
{% for env in gitlab_runner_environment %}
    "{{ env }}"{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
  ]

  [runners.cache]
  [runners.cache.s3]
  [runners.cache.gcs]
  [runners.cache.azure]

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-grafana/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Create Grafana directory tree
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: 472
    group: 472
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - "{{ grafana_data_path | dirname }}"
    - "{{ grafana_data_path }}"
    - "{{ grafana_data_path }}/dashboards"
    - "{{ grafana_data_path }}/provisioning/datasources"
    - "{{ grafana_data_path }}/provisioning/dashboards"

- name: Provision Grafana dashboards and datasources
  when: inventory_hostname in groups['mntr']
  block:
    - name: Copy Grafana datasources provisioning
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml
        dest: "{{ grafana_data_path }}/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml"
        owner: 472
        group: 472
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Copy Grafana dashboards provisioning
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: provisioning/dashboards/dashboards.yml
        dest: "{{ grafana_data_path }}/provisioning/dashboards/dashboards.yml"
        owner: 472
        group: 472
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Copy Grafana dashboard JSON files with subfolders
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: dashboards/
        dest: "{{ grafana_data_path }}/dashboards/"
        owner: "472"
        group: "472"
        mode: "0644"

- name: Deploy Grafana stack
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: deploy-docker-stack
  vars:
    stack_name: grafana
    stack_compose_path: "{{ grafana_data_path }}/compose.yml"


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-grafana/templates/compose.yml.j2
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:{{ grafana_image_tag }}
    networks:
      - traefik-public
      - grafana-internal
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - {{ grafana_data_path }}/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - {{ grafana_data_path }}/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
    environment:
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://{{ grafana_domain }}
      - GF_METRICS_ENABLED=true
      # OAuth через Keycloak
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ENABLED=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_NAME=Keycloak-OAuth
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=true
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID={{ grafana_oauth_id }}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET={{ grafana_oauth_secret }}
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_SCOPES=openid email profile offline_access roles
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_AUTH_URL=https://{{ keycloak_domain }}/realms/{{ keycloak_realm_name }}/protocol/openid-connect/auth
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=http://keycloak:8080/realms/{{ keycloak_realm_name }}/protocol/openid-connect/token
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_API_URL=http://keycloak:8080/realms/{{ keycloak_realm_name }}/protocol/openid-connect/userinfo
      - GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_ROLE_ATTRIBUTE_PATH=contains(roles[*], 'admin') && 'Admin' || contains(roles[*], 'editor') && 'Editor' || 'Viewer'
    deploy:
      labels:
        - "traefik.enable=true"
        - "traefik.http.routers.grafana.rule=Host(`{{ grafana_domain }}`)"
        - "traefik.http.routers.grafana.entrypoints=websecure"
        - "traefik.http.routers.grafana.tls=true"
        - "traefik.http.services.grafana.loadbalancer.server.port=3000"
        - "traefik.swarm.network=traefik-public"
      placement:
        constraints:

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-hashicorp-vault/tasks/init.yml
---
- name: Wait for Vault to be ready
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/health"
    method: GET
    status_code: [200, 429, 472, 473, 501, 503]
  register: vault_health
  until: vault_health.status in [200, 429, 472, 473, 501, 503]
  retries: 30
  delay: 5

- name: Check Vault initialization status
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/init"
    method: GET
    status_code: [200]
  register: vault_init_status

- name: Initialize Vault (First run only)
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/init"
    method: POST
    body_format: json
    body:
      secret_shares: 1
      secret_threshold: 1
    status_code: [200]
  register: vault_init_result
  when: vault_init_status.json is defined and not vault_init_status.json.initialized

- name: Save Vault keys to disk
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_init_result.json | to_nice_json }}"
    dest: "{{ vault_data_path }}/vault_keys.json"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0400"
  when:
    - vault_init_result is defined
    - vault_init_result is not skipped
    - vault_init_result.json is defined
  no_log: true

# === Credentials ===
- name: Set Vault credentials from new initialization
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    vault_token: "{{ vault_init_result.json.root_token }}"
    vault_unseal_key: "{{ vault_init_result.json.keys_base64[0] }}"
  when:
    - vault_init_result is defined
    - vault_init_result is not skipped
    - vault_init_result.json is defined
    - vault_init_result.json.root_token is defined
  no_log: true

- name: Load existing Vault keys if already initialized
  when:
    - vault_init_status.json is defined
    - vault_init_status.json.initialized | default(false)
    - vault_init_result is skipped or (vault_init_result is defined and not (vault_init_result.json is defined))
  block:
    - name: Check if vault_keys.json exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ vault_data_path }}/vault_keys.json"
      register: vault_keys_file_stat

    - name: Fail if vault_keys.json is missing
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Vault is initialized but {{ vault_data_path }}/vault_keys.json is missing"
      when: not vault_keys_file_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Read Vault keys from disk
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: "{{ vault_data_path }}/vault_keys.json"
      register: vault_keys_file

    - name: Set Vault credentials from existing file
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        vault_token: "{{ (vault_keys_file.content | b64decode | from_json).root_token }}"
        vault_unseal_key: "{{ (vault_keys_file.content | b64decode | from_json).keys_base64[0] }}"
  no_log: true
# === Unseal ===
- name: Check Vault seal status
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/seal-status"
    method: GET
    status_code: [200, 503]
  register: vault_seal_status

- name: Unseal Vault
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/unseal"
    method: POST
    body_format: json
    body:
      key: "{{ vault_unseal_key }}"
    status_code: [200]
  when:
    - vault_seal_status.json is defined
    - vault_seal_status.json.sealed | default(false)
    - vault_unseal_key is defined
  register: unseal_result
  retries: 3
  delay: 2
  until: unseal_result is not failed

- name: Verify Vault is unsealed
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/seal-status"
    method: GET
    status_code: [200]
  register: final_seal_status
  when: unseal_result is changed
  failed_when: final_seal_status.json.sealed


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-hashicorp-vault/tasks/issue.yml
---
- name: Create certs directory
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ vault_data_path }}/certs"
    state: directory
    mode: "0755"
    owner: root
    group: root

- name: Check if initial certificate exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ vault_data_path }}/certs/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt"
  register: cert_file

- name: Check certificate expiration
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    openssl x509 -in {{ vault_data_path }}/certs/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt -checkend 864000 -noout
  register: cert_validity
  failed_when: false
  changed_when: false
  when: cert_file.stat.exists

- name: Issue universal certificate (Apex + Wildcard)
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/issue/{{ vault_role_name }}"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      common_name: "{{ vault_allowed_domain }}"
      alt_names: "{{ vault_allowed_domain }},*.{{ vault_allowed_domain }}"
      ttl: "{{ vault_cert_ttl }}"
      format: "pem"
      private_key_format: "pem"
      exclude_cn_from_sans: true
    status_code: [200]
  register: issued_cert
  when: not cert_file.stat.exists or (cert_file.stat.exists and cert_validity.rc != 0)
  no_log: true

# === ATOMIC WRITE ===
- name: Create temporary directory for new certs
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "/tmp/vault"
    state: directory
    mode: "0755"
    owner: root
    group: root
  when: issued_cert.json is defined

- name: Save Fullchain (Certificate + CA Chain) to temp
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ issued_cert.json.data.certificate }}\n{{ issued_cert.json.data.ca_chain | join('\n') }}"
    dest: "/tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt"
    mode: "0644"
  when: issued_cert.json is defined

- name: Save issued private key to temp
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ issued_cert.json.data.private_key }}"
    dest: "/tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.key"
    mode: "0600"
  when: issued_cert.json is defined

- name: Verify key matches certificate before applying
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    set -euo pipefail
    cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -noout -pubkey -in /tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt)
    key_pub=$(openssl pkey -pubout -in /tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.key)
    if [ "$cert_pub" != "$key_pub" ]; then
      echo "Certificate and private key do not match" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  register: key_match_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: key_match_check.rc != 0
  when: issued_cert.json is defined

- name: Replace old certs in Vault directory
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    rm -f {{ vault_data_path }}/certs/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt {{ vault_data_path }}/certs/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.key
    mv /tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.crt {{ vault_data_path }}/certs/
    mv /tmp/vault/{{ vault_allowed_domain }}.key {{ vault_data_path }}/certs/
    rmdir /tmp/vault/
  when:
    - issued_cert.json is defined
    - key_match_check.rc | default(1) == 0

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-hashicorp-vault/tasks/pki.yml
---
- name: Get enabled mounts
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/mounts"
    method: GET
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
  register: vault_mounts

# === ROOT CA ===
- name: Enable Root PKI engine
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/mounts/{{ vault_root_pki }}"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      type: "pki"
      config:
        max_lease_ttl: "{{ vault_root_ttl }}"
    status_code: [200, 204]
  when: (vault_root_pki ~ '/') not in vault_mounts.json

- name: Check Root CA existence
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/issuers?list=true"
    method: GET
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    status_code: [200, 404]
  register: root_issuers

- name: Generate Root CA
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/root/generate/internal"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      common_name: "{{ vault_root_common_name }}"
      ttl: "{{ vault_root_ttl }}"
      issuer_name: "root-ca"
    status_code: [200, 204]
  when: root_issuers.status == 404 or (root_issuers.json.data['keys'] | default([]) | length == 0)

- name: Configure Root CA URLs (AIA)
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/config/urls"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      issuing_certificates: "https://{{ vault_domain }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/ca"
      crl_distribution_points: "https://{{ vault_domain }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/crl"
    status_code: [200, 204]

- name: Download Root CA public certificate
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/ca/pem"
    dest: "{{ vault_data_path }}/certs/root-ca.crt"
    mode: "0644"

# === Распространение CA на ВСЕ хосты ===
- name: Read Vault Root CA certificate
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ vault_data_path }}/certs/root-ca.crt"
  register: vault_root_ca_content

- name: Install Vault Root CA into system trust store on all hosts
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_root_ca_content.content | b64decode }}"
    dest: /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/vault-root-ca.crt
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  delegate_to: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ groups['all'] }}"
  register: ca_installed_all

- name: Update CA certificates on all hosts
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: update-ca-certificates
  delegate_to: "{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ groups['all'] }}"
  when: ca_installed_all.changed
  changed_when: true

# === INTERMEDIATE CA ===
- name: Enable Intermediate PKI engine
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/sys/mounts/{{ vault_int_pki }}"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      type: "pki"
      config:
        max_lease_ttl: "{{ vault_int_ttl }}"
    status_code: [200, 204]
  when: (vault_int_pki ~ '/') not in vault_mounts.json

- name: Check Intermediate CA existence
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/issuers?list=true"
    method: GET
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    status_code: [200, 404]
  register: int_issuers

- name: Generate and Configure Intermediate CA
  when: int_issuers.status == 404 or (int_issuers.json.data['keys'] | default([]) | length == 0)
  block:
    - name: Generate Intermediate CSR
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/intermediate/generate/internal"
        method: POST
        headers:
          X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
        body_format: json
        body:
          common_name: "{{ vault_intermediate_common_name }}"
          issuer_name: "int-ca"
        status_code: [200, 204]
      register: int_csr_result

    - name: Sign Intermediate CSR with Root CA
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_root_pki }}/root/sign-intermediate"
        method: POST
        headers:
          X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
        body_format: json
        body:
          issuer_ref: "root-ca"
          csr: "{{ int_csr_result.json.data.csr }}"
          format: "pem_bundle"
          ttl: "{{ vault_int_ttl }}"
        status_code: [200, 204]
      register: signed_int_result

    - name: Import Signed Intermediate Certificate
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/intermediate/set-signed"
        method: POST
        headers:
          X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
        body_format: json
        body:
          certificate: "{{ signed_int_result.json.data.certificate }}"
        status_code: [200, 204]

- name: Configure Intermediate CA URLs (AIA)
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/config/urls"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      issuing_certificates: "https://{{ vault_domain }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/ca"
      crl_distribution_points: "https://{{ vault_domain }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/crl"
    status_code: [200, 204]

# === ROLE ===
- name: Check Role existence
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/roles/{{ vault_role_name }}"
    method: GET
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    status_code: [200, 404]
  register: role_check

- name: Create Role for Intermediate CA
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}/v1/{{ vault_int_pki }}/roles/{{ vault_role_name }}"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body_format: json
    body:
      issuer_ref: "default"
      allowed_domains:
        - "{{ vault_allowed_domain }}"
      allow_bare_domains: true
      allow_subdomains: true
      allow_wildcard_certificates: true
      max_ttl: "{{ vault_cert_ttl }}"
    status_code: [200, 204]
  when: role_check.status == 404


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-hashicorp-vault/templates/compose.yml.j2
services:
  vault:
    image: hashicorp/vault:{{ vault_image_tag }}
    command: server
    environment:
      VAULT_ADDR: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}"
      VAULT_LOCAL_CONFIG: |
        {
          "storage": {
            "raft": {
              "path": "/vault/file",
              "node_id": "{{ vault_raft_node_id }}"
            }
          },
          "listener": [
            {
              "tcp": {
                "address": "0.0.0.0:{{ vault_port }}",
                "tls_disable": true,
                "telemetry": {
                  "unauthenticated_metrics_access": true
                }
              }
            }
          ],
          "telemetry": {
            "prometheus_retention_time": "60s",
            "disable_hostname": true
          },
          "default_lease_ttl": "{{ vault_default_lease_ttl }}",
          "max_lease_ttl": "{{ vault_max_lease_ttl }}",
          "ui": true,
          "api_addr": "https://{{ vault_domain }}",
          "cluster_addr": "https://{{ vault_domain }}:8201",
          "disable_mlock": true
        }
    volumes:
      - vault_data:/vault/file
    networks:
      - traefik-public
      - grafana-internal
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:{{ vault_port }}:{{ vault_port }}/tcp"
    deploy:
      labels:
        - "traefik.enable=true"
        - "traefik.http.routers.vault.rule=Host(`{{ vault_domain }}`)"
        - "traefik.http.routers.vault.entrypoints=websecure"
        - "traefik.http.routers.vault.tls=true"
        - "traefik.http.services.vault.loadbalancer.server.port={{ vault_port }}"
        - "traefik.swarm.network=traefik-public"
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.role == manager
      restart_policy:
        condition: on-failure
        delay: 10s
        max_attempts: 5
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      rollback_config:
        order: stop-first

volumes:
  vault_data:
    name: vault_data

networks:
  traefik-public:
    external: true
  grafana-internal:
    external: true

# Backup settings
postgres_container_name: "postgres_postgres"
backup_retention_days: 7
backup_schedule_hour: "2"
backup_schedule_minute: "0"
backup_data_path: "/opt/postgres-backup"
backup_encryption_key: ""

# Databases to backup
backup_databases:
  - "{{ keycloak_db }}"


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-postgres-backup/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Install required packages for backup on DB node
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
      - cron
      - gzip
      - rclone
    state: present
    update_cache: true

- name: Create backup directories on DB node
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0750"
  loop:
    - "{{ backup_data_path }}/tmp"
    - /root/.config/rclone

- name: Fetch Vault CA from mgmt node
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "/opt/vault/certs/root-ca.crt"
  delegate_to: "{{ groups['mgmt'][0] }}"
  register: vault_ca_file

- name: Install Vault CA to system trusted store
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ vault_ca_file.content | b64decode }}"
    dest: "/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/vault-ca.crt"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  register: vault_ca_installed

- name: Update CA certificates
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: update-ca-certificates
  when: vault_ca_installed.changed

- name: Configure rclone for RustFS S3
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: rclone.conf.j2
    dest: /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0600"
  no_log: true

- name: Deploy backup script to DB node
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: backup-postgres.sh.j2
    dest: /usr/local/bin/backup-postgres.sh
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0750"

- name: Deploy restore script to DB node
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: restore-postgres.sh.j2
    dest: /usr/local/bin/restore-postgres.sh
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0750"

- name: Setup cron job for daily backups on DB node
  ansible.builtin.cron:
    name: "PostgreSQL S3 Backup"
    minute: "{{ backup_schedule_minute }}"
    hour: "{{ backup_schedule_hour }}"
    job: "/usr/local/bin/backup-postgres.sh >> /var/log/postgres-backup.log 2>&1"
    user: root

- name: Check if initial backup exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /var/log/postgres-backup.log
  register: backup_log

- name: Run initial backup to verify configuration
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: /usr/local/bin/backup-postgres.sh
  register: initial_backup
  changed_when: initial_backup.rc == 0
  when: not backup_log.stat.exists


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-postgres-backup/templates/backup-postgres.sh.j2
#!/bin/bash
# {{ ansible_managed }}
set -euo pipefail

DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RCLONE_REMOTE="rustfs"
S3_BUCKET="{{ s3_bucket }}"
BACKUP_DIR="{{ backup_data_path }}/tmp"
RETENTION_DAYS="{{ backup_retention_days }}"
GPG_PASSPHRASE="{{ backup_encryption_key | default('') }}"

CONTAINER_ID=$(docker ps -q -f "name={{ postgres_container_name }}" | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${CONTAINER_ID}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: PostgreSQL container not found!"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${BACKUP_DIR}"

echo "[$(date)] Ensuring S3 bucket exists..."
rclone mkdir "${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}"

echo "=== [$(date)] Starting PostgreSQL backup ==="

{% for db in backup_databases %}
echo "[$(date)] Backing up database: {{ db }}"
BACKUP_FILE="${BACKUP_DIR}/{{ db }}_${DATE}.sql.gz"

docker exec -i "${CONTAINER_ID}" pg_dump -U postgres -d "{{ db }}" | gzip > "${BACKUP_FILE}"

if [ -f "${BACKUP_FILE}" ] && [ -s "${BACKUP_FILE}" ]; then
    FILE_SIZE=$(du -h "${BACKUP_FILE}" | cut -f1)
    echo "[$(date)] Backup created: ${BACKUP_FILE} (${FILE_SIZE})"

{% if vault_backup_encryption_key is defined and vault_backup_encryption_key | length > 0 %}
    # Encrypt backup with GPG symmetric encryption
    ENCRYPTED_FILE="${BACKUP_FILE}.gpg"
    gpg --batch --yes --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 \
        --passphrase "${GPG_PASSPHRASE}" \
        --output "${ENCRYPTED_FILE}" "${BACKUP_FILE}"
    rm -f "${BACKUP_FILE}"
    UPLOAD_FILE="${ENCRYPTED_FILE}"
    REMOTE_NAME="{{ db }}/${DATE}.sql.gz.gpg"
    echo "[$(date)] Backup encrypted: ${ENCRYPTED_FILE}"
{% else %}
    UPLOAD_FILE="${BACKUP_FILE}"
    REMOTE_NAME="{{ db }}/${DATE}.sql.gz"
{% endif %}

    rclone copyto "${UPLOAD_FILE}" "${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}/${REMOTE_NAME}"
    echo "[$(date)] Uploaded: ${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}/${REMOTE_NAME}"
else
    echo "ERROR: Backup file is empty or missing for {{ db }}"
    exit 1
fi
{% endfor %}

find "${BACKUP_DIR}" -name "*.sql.gz*" -mtime +1 -delete

echo "[$(date)] Cleaning S3 backups older than ${RETENTION_DAYS} days"
rclone delete "${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}" --min-age "${RETENTION_DAYS}d"

echo "=== [$(date)] Backup completed successfully ==="

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-postgres-backup/templates/rclone.conf.j2
# {{ ansible_managed }}
[rustfs]
type = s3
provider = Minio
access_key_id = {{ s3_access_key }}
secret_access_key = {{ s3_secret_key }}
endpoint = {{ s3_endpoint }}
acl = private
no_check_certificate = true

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-postgres-backup/templates/restore-postgres.sh.j2
#!/bin/bash
# {{ ansible_managed }}

# Usage: restore-postgres.sh <s3-key> [database-name]

set -euo pipefail

RCLONE_REMOTE="rustfs"
S3_BUCKET="{{ s3_bucket }}"
RESTORE_DIR="/tmp/pg_restore"

# Динамический поиск ID контейнера в Docker Swarm
CONTAINER_ID=$(docker ps -q -f "name=postgres_postgres" | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${CONTAINER_ID}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: PostgreSQL container not found!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <s3-backup-key> [target-database]"
    echo ""
    echo "Available backups:"
    rclone lsl "${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}/" | awk '{print $4}' || echo "No backups found."
    exit 1
fi

S3_KEY="$1"
TARGET_DB="${2:-}"

mkdir -p "${RESTORE_DIR}"
LOCAL_FILE="${RESTORE_DIR}/$(basename "${S3_KEY}")"

echo "=== Restoring from ${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_KEY} ==="

rclone copyto "${RCLONE_REMOTE}:${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_KEY}" "${LOCAL_FILE}"

echo "Downloaded: ${LOCAL_FILE}"

# Восстановление через ID контейнера
gunzip -c "${LOCAL_FILE}" | docker exec -i "${CONTAINER_ID}" psql -U postgres ${TARGET_DB:+-d "${TARGET_DB}"}

echo "=== Restore completed successfully ==="

rm -f "${LOCAL_FILE}"

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-prometheus/templates/rules.yml.j2
# {{ ansible_managed }}

groups:
  - name: system_alerts
    rules:
      - alert: InstanceDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Instance {{ "{{ $labels.instance }}" }} down"
          description: "{{ "{{ $labels.instance }}" }} of job {{ "{{ $labels.job }}" }} has been down for more than 2 minutes."

      - alert: HighCPU
        expr: 100 - (avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100) > 85
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High CPU usage on {{ "{{ $labels.instance }}" }}"
          description: "CPU usage is above 85% for 5 minutes (current value: {{ "{{ $value }}" }}%)."

      - alert: HighMemory
        expr: (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100 > 90
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory usage on {{ "{{ $labels.instance }}" }}"
          description: "Memory usage is above 90% for 5 minutes (current value: {{ "{{ $value }}" }}%)."

      - alert: DiskSpaceLow
        expr: (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs"}) * 100 < 20
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Disk almost full on {{ "{{ $labels.instance }}" }} ({{ "{{ $labels.mountpoint }}" }})"
          description: "Less than 20% disk space remaining on {{ "{{ $labels.mountpoint }}" }}."

      - alert: ContainerHighCPU
        expr: sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[5m])) * 100 > 80
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Container {{ "{{ $labels.name }}" }} high CPU usage"
          description: "Container CPU usage is above 80% of one core for 5 minutes."

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/deploy-traefik/files/cert-renew.sh
#!/bin/sh
# Автоматическая ротация TLS-сертификата через HashiCorp Vault PKI.
set -eu

# ── Настройки (передаются через ENV) ──────────────────────────
VAULT_ADDR="${VAULT_ADDR:-http://vault:8200}"
VAULT_TOKEN_FILE="${VAULT_TOKEN_FILE}"
PKI_PATH="${PKI_PATH}"
PKI_ROLE="${PKI_ROLE}"
COMMON_NAME="${COMMON_NAME}"
ALT_NAMES="${ALT_NAMES}"
CERT_TTL="${CERT_TTL:-720h}"
CERT_DIR="${CERT_DIR:-/certs}"
CHECK_INTERVAL="${CHECK_INTERVAL:-3600}"
RENEW_THRESHOLD="${RENEW_THRESHOLD:-86400}"

CERT_FILE="${CERT_DIR}/${COMMON_NAME}.crt"
KEY_FILE="${CERT_DIR}/${COMMON_NAME}.key"

log() { echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')] $*"; }

# ── Чтение токена ─────────────────────────────────────────────
get_token() {
    if [ -f "$VAULT_TOKEN_FILE" ]; then
        TOKEN=$(jq -r '.root_token' "$VAULT_TOKEN_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
    fi
    if [ -z "${TOKEN:-}" ] || [ "$TOKEN" = "null" ]; then
        log "ERROR: cannot read Vault token from ${VAULT_TOKEN_FILE}"
        return 1
    fi
}

# ── Проверка: нужен ли новый сертификат? ──────────────────────
needs_renewal() {
    [ ! -f "$CERT_FILE" ] && return 0
    [ ! -f "$KEY_FILE" ]  && return 0
    
    if ! openssl x509 -in "$CERT_FILE" -checkend "$RENEW_THRESHOLD" -noout 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi
    
    cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -noout -pubkey -in "$CERT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
    key_pub=$(openssl pkey -pubout -in "$KEY_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ "$cert_pub" != "$key_pub" ] && return 0
    
    return 1
}

# ── Выпуск нового сертификата ─────────────────────────────────
issue_cert() {
    log "Issuing new certificate: CN=${COMMON_NAME}, TTL=${CERT_TTL}"
    
    RESPONSE=$(wget -qO- \
        --header="X-Vault-Token: ${TOKEN}" \
        --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
        --post-data="{
            \"common_name\": \"${COMMON_NAME}\",
            \"alt_names\": \"${ALT_NAMES}\",
            \"ttl\": \"${CERT_TTL}\",
            \"format\": \"pem\",
            \"private_key_format\": \"pem\"
        }" \
        "${VAULT_ADDR}/v1/${PKI_PATH}/issue/${PKI_ROLE}") || {
        log "ERROR: Vault PKI issue request failed"
        return 1
    }
    
    NEW_CERT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.certificate')
    NEW_KEY=$(echo "$RESPONSE"  | jq -r '.data.private_key')
    CA_CHAIN=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.ca_chain | join("\n")')
    
    if [ -z "$NEW_CERT" ] || [ "$NEW_CERT" = "null" ] || \
    [ -z "$NEW_KEY" ]  || [ "$NEW_KEY" = "null" ]; then
        log "ERROR: empty certificate or key in Vault response"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Атомарная запись через временные файлы
    TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
    printf '%s\n%s\n' "$NEW_CERT" "$CA_CHAIN" > "${TMP_DIR}/cert.pem"
    printf '%s\n' "$NEW_KEY"                  > "${TMP_DIR}/key.pem"
    
    # Валидация: ключ совпадает с сертификатом
    c_pub=$(openssl x509 -noout -pubkey -in "${TMP_DIR}/cert.pem" 2>/dev/null)
    k_pub=$(openssl pkey  -pubout       -in "${TMP_DIR}/key.pem"  2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$c_pub" != "$k_pub" ]; then
        log "ERROR: key/cert mismatch, aborting"
        rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"
        return 1
    fi
    
    mv "${TMP_DIR}/cert.pem" "$CERT_FILE"
    mv "${TMP_DIR}/key.pem"  "$KEY_FILE"
    chmod 644 "$CERT_FILE"
    chmod 600 "$KEY_FILE"
    rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"
    
    EXPIRY=$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT_FILE" | cut -d= -f2)
    log "OK: certificate renewed, expires ${EXPIRY}"
}

# ── Основной цикл ─────────────────────────────────────────────
log "cert-renewer started (interval=${CHECK_INTERVAL}s, threshold=${RENEW_THRESHOLD}s)"

while true; do
    get_token || { sleep 30; continue; }
    
    if needs_renewal; then
        log "Certificate missing or expiring soon — renewing"
        issue_cert || log "WARN: renewal failed, will retry in ${CHECK_INTERVAL}s"
    else
        EXPIRY=$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT_FILE" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
        log "Certificate valid (expires ${EXPIRY}), next check in ${CHECK_INTERVAL}s"
    fi
    
    sleep "$CHECK_INTERVAL"
done

- name: Create Traefik config directories

    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    mode: "0755"
    owner: root
    group: root
  loop:
    - "{{ traefik_data_path }}"
    - "{{ traefik_data_path }}/dynamic"
    - "{{ traefik_data_path }}/certs"

- name: Generate Traefik static config (traefik.yml)
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: traefik.yml.j2
    dest: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/traefik.yml"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"

- name: Check if Vault certificate exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "/opt/vault/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
  register: vault_cert_file

- name: Check if Traefik certificate exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
  register: traefik_cert_file

- name: Compare Vault and Traefik certificate checksums
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    checksum_algorithm: sha256
  register: cert_checksums
  loop:
    - "/opt/vault/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
    - "{{ traefik_data_path }}/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
  when: vault_cert_file.stat.exists and traefik_cert_file.stat.exists

- name: Process Vault certificates for Traefik
  when: >
    vault_cert_file.stat.exists and
    (not traefik_cert_file.stat.exists or
     (cert_checksums.results | default([]) | length == 2 and
      cert_checksums.results[0].stat.checksum != cert_checksums.results[1].stat.checksum))
  block:
    - name: Copy certificate to Traefik certs directory
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/opt/vault/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
        dest: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.crt"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        remote_src: true
      notify: Restart traefik stack

    - name: Copy private key to Traefik certs directory
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/opt/vault/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.key"
        dest: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/certs/{{ fulldomain }}.key"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"
        remote_src: true
      notify: Restart traefik stack

    - name: Generate Traefik dynamic TLS (dynamic/tls.yml)
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: dynamic/tls.yml.j2
        dest: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/dynamic/tls.yml"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when: vault_cert_file.stat.exists
      notify: Restart traefik stack

- name: Copy cert-renew script to Traefik directory
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: cert-renew.sh
    dest: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/cert-renew.sh"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"

- name: Deploy Traefik stack
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: deploy-docker-stack
  vars:
    stack_name: traefik
    stack_compose_path: "{{ traefik_data_path }}/compose.yml"

    cmd: docker info --format '{{ "{{ .Swarm.LocalNodeState }}" }}'
  register: set_docker_swarm_status_primary
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  when: inventory_hostname == groups['swarm_managers'][0]

  ansible.builtin.command:

  changed_when: true

- name: Wait for Swarm API to be ready after initialization
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker info --format '{{ "{{ .Swarm.LocalNodeState }}" }}'
  register: set_docker_swarm_wait
  until: set_docker_swarm_wait.stdout | trim == "active"
  retries: 10
  delay: 3
  changed_when: false
  when:

    - set_docker_swarm_init_result is defined
    - set_docker_swarm_init_result.changed

  register: set_docker_swarm_worker_token_result

  no_log: true

- name: Get Swarm manager token
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker swarm join-token -q manager
  register: set_docker_swarm_manager_token_result
  changed_when: false
  when: inventory_hostname == groups['swarm_managers'][0]
  no_log: true

# ======================

- name: Set Swarm tokens as facts for all hosts
  vars:
    swarm_primary: "{{ groups['swarm_managers'] | first }}"
    swarm_primary_worker_token: >-
      {{ hostvars[swarm_primary].set_docker_swarm_worker_token_result.stdout | default('') | trim }}
    swarm_primary_manager_token: >-
      {{ hostvars[swarm_primary].set_docker_swarm_manager_token_result.stdout | default('') | trim }}
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    set_docker_swarm_worker_token: "{{ swarm_primary_worker_token }}"
    set_docker_swarm_manager_token: "{{ swarm_primary_manager_token }}"
    set_docker_swarm_advertise_addr: "{{ hostvars[swarm_primary].ip_address }}"
  when:
    - swarm_primary_worker_token | length > 0
    - swarm_primary_manager_token | length > 0
  no_log: true

# CHECK SWARM STATUS ON ALL NODES
# ======================

  ansible.builtin.command:

  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

# JOIN SECONDARY MANAGERS
# ======================

    - inventory_hostname != groups['swarm_managers'][0]
    - set_docker_swarm_status.stdout is defined
    - set_docker_swarm_status.stdout | trim == "inactive"
    - set_docker_swarm_manager_token is defined
  changed_when: true
# ======================
# JOIN WORKERS
# ======================

- name: Join workers to Swarm
  ansible.builtin.command:
    cmd: docker swarm join --token {{ set_docker_swarm_worker_token }} {{ set_docker_swarm_advertise_addr }}:2377
  when:
    - inventory_hostname in groups['swarm_workers']
    - set_docker_swarm_status.stdout is defined
    - set_docker_swarm_status.stdout | trim == "inactive"
    - set_docker_swarm_worker_token is defined
  changed_when: true

# Docker Swarm firewall rules

define swarm_nodes = { {{ groups['all'] | map('extract', hostvars, 'ansible_host') | unique | join(', ') }} }

# Swarm manager API
ip saddr $swarm_nodes tcp dport 2377 accept;

# Swarm node communication (TCP and UDP)
ip saddr $swarm_nodes tcp dport 7946 accept;
ip saddr $swarm_nodes udp dport 7946 accept;

# Overlay network traffic
ip saddr $swarm_nodes udp dport 4789 accept;

# ISAKMP / IKE (для обмена ключами шифрования Swarm)
ip saddr $swarm_nodes udp dport 500 accept;

# IPsec ESP и AH протоколы (для самого зашифрованного трафика)
ip saddr $swarm_nodes ip protocol esp accept;
ip saddr $swarm_nodes ip protocol ah accept;

#!/usr/sbin/nft -f
# {{ ansible_managed }}

table inet firewall
flush table inet firewall

table inet firewall {
    chain input {
        type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;

        # Loopback
        iifname "lo" accept

        # Established and related connections
        ct state established,related accept
        ct state invalid drop

        # ICMP
        ip protocol icmp accept
        ip6 nexthdr ipv6-icmp accept

        # SSH
        tcp dport {{ set_firewall_ssh_port }} accept;

        # Include additional rules
        include "/etc/nftables.d/*.nft";
    }

    chain forward {
        type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;

        # Established connections
        ct state established,related accept

        # Docker bridge networks
        iifname "docker0" accept
        oifname "docker0" accept

        # Docker Swarm overlay networks
        iifname "br-*" accept
        oifname "br-*" accept

        # Docker gateway bridge
        iifname "docker_gwbridge" accept
        oifname "docker_gwbridge" accept
    }

    chain output {
        type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
    }
}

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_hostname/defaults/main.yml
---
set_hostname_name: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_hostname/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Set system hostname
  ansible.builtin.hostname:
    name: "{{ set_hostname_name }}"
    use: systemd
  when: ansible_facts.hostname != set_hostname_name
  register: set_hostname_result

- name: Ensure /etc/hosts has localhost hostname mapping
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/hosts
    regexp: '^127\.0\.1\.1'
    line: "127.0.1.1 {{ set_hostname_name }}"
    state: present

- name: Ensure hostname is in /etc/hosts
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/hosts
    regexp: "^{{ ip_address }}"
    line: "{{ ip_address }} {{ set_hostname_name }}"
    state: present
  when: ip_address is defined

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_motd/templates/motd.j2
#!/bin/bash
# {{ ansible_managed }}

HOSTNAME=$(hostname)
{% if set_motd_show_os %}
OS=$(lsb_release -d 2>/dev/null | cut -f2 || cat /etc/os-release | grep PRETTY_NAME | cut -d'"' -f2)
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_kernel %}
KERNEL=$(uname -r)
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_uptime %}
UPTIME=$(uptime -p | sed 's/up //')
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_cpu %}
CPU_CORES=$(nproc)
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_memory %}
MEMORY_TOTAL=$(free -h | grep Mem | awk '{print $2}')
MEMORY_FREE=$(free -h | grep Mem | awk '{print $4}')
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_disk %}
DISK_TOTAL=$(df -h / | grep / | awk '{print $2}')
DISK_FREE=$(df -h / | grep / | awk '{print $4}')
{% endif %}

echo "----------------------------------------------"
{% if set_motd_show_hostname %}
echo "  Welcome to $HOSTNAME"
{% endif %}
echo "----------------------------------------------"
{% if set_motd_show_os %}
echo "  OS: $OS"
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_kernel %}
echo "  Kernel: $KERNEL"
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_uptime %}
echo "  Uptime: $UPTIME"
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_cpu %}
echo "  CPU: $CPU_CORES cores"
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_memory %}
echo "  Memory: $MEMORY_TOTAL total, $MEMORY_FREE free"
{% endif %}
{% if set_motd_show_disk %}
echo "  Disk: $DISK_TOTAL total, $DISK_FREE free"
{% endif %}
echo "----------------------------------------------"

    - Validate netplan configuration
    - Apply netplan configuration

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_packages/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Update APT cache
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    update_cache: true
    cache_valid_time: 3600

- name: Install base utility packages
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: "{{ set_packages_apt }}"
    state: present
  register: set_packages_package_install
  retries: 3
  delay: 5
  until: set_packages_package_install is success

- name: Enable unattended security upgrades
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
    content: |
      APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";
      APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";
      APT::Periodic::Download-Upgradeable-Packages "1";
      APT::Periodic::AutocleanInterval "7";

- name: Remove unwanted packages
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: "{{ set_packages_apt_remove }}"
    state: absent
    purge: true
  when: set_packages_apt_remove is defined

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_ssh/defaults/main.yml
---
set_ssh_port: 22
set_ssh_permit_root_login: "no"
set_ssh_password_authentication: "no"
set_ssh_pubkey_authentication: "yes"
set_ssh_permit_empty_passwords: "no"
set_ssh_ciphers: "chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com"
set_ssh_macs: "hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com"
set_ssh_max_auth_tries: 3
set_ssh_client_alive_interval: 300
set_ssh_client_alive_count_max: 2


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_ssh/handlers/main.yml
---
- name: Restart SSH
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: ssh

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_ssh/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Remove cloud-init SSH drop-in if present
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/50-cloud-init.conf
    state: absent
  notify: Restart SSH

- name: Harden SSH configuration
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regexp: "{{ item.regexp }}"
    line: "{{ item.line }}"
    state: present
    backup: true
    validate: /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s
  loop:
    - regexp: "^#?Port"
      line: "Port {{ set_ssh_port }}"
    - regexp: "^#?PermitRootLogin"
      line: "PermitRootLogin {{ set_ssh_permit_root_login }}"
    - regexp: "^#?PasswordAuthentication"
      line: "PasswordAuthentication {{ set_ssh_password_authentication }}"
    - regexp: "^#?PubkeyAuthentication"
      line: "PubkeyAuthentication {{ set_ssh_pubkey_authentication }}"
    - regexp: "^#?PermitEmptyPasswords"
      line: "PermitEmptyPasswords {{ set_ssh_permit_empty_passwords }}"
    - regexp: "^#?Ciphers"
      line: "Ciphers {{ set_ssh_ciphers }}"
    - regexp: "^#?MACs"
      line: "MACs {{ set_ssh_macs }}"
    - regexp: "^#?X11Forwarding"
      line: "X11Forwarding no"
    - regexp: "^#?MaxAuthTries"
      line: "MaxAuthTries {{ set_ssh_max_auth_tries }}"
    - regexp: "^#?ClientAliveInterval"
      line: "ClientAliveInterval {{ set_ssh_client_alive_interval }}"
    - regexp: "^#?ClientAliveCountMax"
      line: "ClientAliveCountMax {{ set_ssh_client_alive_count_max }}"
  notify: Restart SSH

- name: Ensure SSH service is enabled
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: ssh
    enabled: true
    state: started

# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_users/defaults/main.yml
---
set_users_sudo_groups:
  - sudo

set_users_deploy_groups: []

set_users_sudo: []

set_users_deploy: []


# /home/dauxdu/Documents/github/vsfi-2026/ansible/roles/set_users/tasks/main.yml
---
- name: Ensure sudo package is installed
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: sudo
    state: present
    cache_valid_time: 3600

- name: Create sudo user groups
  ansible.builtin.group:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: present
  loop: "{{ set_users_sudo_groups | default([]) }}"

- name: Create deploy user groups
  ansible.builtin.group:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: present
  loop: "{{ set_users_deploy_groups | default([]) }}"

- name: Create sudo users
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    state: present
    groups: "{{ set_users_sudo_groups | join(',') }}"
    append: true
    shell: /bin/bash
    create_home: true
    password_lock: false
  loop: "{{ set_users_sudo | default([]) }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"

- name: Create deploy users
  ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    state: present
    groups: "{{ set_users_deploy_groups | join(',') }}"
    append: true
    shell: /bin/bash
    create_home: true
    password_lock: true
  loop: "{{ set_users_deploy | default([]) }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"

- name: Configure sudo access for admin users
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: "/etc/sudoers.d/{{ item.name }}"
    content: "{{ item.name }} ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n"
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0440"
    validate: "/usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s"
  loop: "{{ set_users_sudo }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"
  when: set_users_sudo | length > 0

- name: Configure restricted sudo for deploy users
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: "/etc/sudoers.d/{{ item.name }}"
    content: >-
      {{ item.name }} ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl,
      /usr/bin/docker stack *, /usr/bin/docker service *, /usr/bin/docker ps *
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0440"
    validate: "/usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s"
  loop: "{{ set_users_deploy }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"
  when: set_users_deploy | length > 0

- name: Manage SSH authorized keys for sudo users
  ansible.posix.authorized_key:
    user: "{{ item.name }}"
    state: present
    key: "{{ item.ssh_public_key }}"
    exclusive: false
  loop: "{{ set_users_sudo }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"
  when: set_users_sudo | length > 0

- name: Manage SSH authorized keys for deploy users
  ansible.posix.authorized_key:
    user: "{{ item.name }}"
    state: present
    key: "{{ item.ssh_public_key }}"
    exclusive: false
  loop: "{{ set_users_deploy }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"
  when: set_users_deploy | length > 0
